# 2026 in India

This article is about events of the year 2026 in India.

## Events

### January

- 1 January – The Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention 2026 commences in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
- 9 January – The Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention 2026 ends.
- 12 January – Bihar Legislative Assembly building is inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu.
- 12 January – Satish Chandra Sharma takes charge as the new Chief Justice of Allahabad High Court.
- 17 January – P. K. Mishra is reappointed as the principal secretary to the Prime Minister.
- 20 January – The Akal Takht appoints Giani Raghbir Singh as the new Jathedar.
- 27 January – The Enforcement Directorate arrests Aam Aadmi Party leader Satyendar Jain in a money laundering case.
- 28 January – Satyendar Jain receives bail from Delhi High Court.

### February

- 3 February – The Union Budget for 2026-27 is presented by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.
- 18 February – Kuki-Zo insurgent groups and the Indian government sign a peace accord brokered by Myanmar.
- 28 February – Mohanlal Bhandare, the 22nd Governor of Odisha, passes away.

### March

- 4 March – The Aam Aadmi Party wins the Delhi Legislative Assembly election.

### April

- 1 April – WAVES 2026 begins in Mumbai.
- 6 April – WAVES 2026 ends.

### May

- 23 May – The Election Commission of India announces the schedule for the 2026 Bihar Legislative Assembly election.

### June

- 4 June – Bihar Legislative Assembly election concludes.

### July

- 3 July – The results for the 2026 Bihar Legislative Assembly election are declared, with the NDA winning a majority.
- 17 July – Dharmendra Pradhan resigns as Union Education Minister following the controversy over NEET exam.
- 21 July – Samrat Choudhary takes oath as the Chief Minister of Bihar.
